content.title: Sleeper - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms
content.text: Other forms: sleepers A sleeper is something that succeeds when no one thought it would. That low-tech movie about shark attacks that you shot on vacation and edited in your basement? It could be a sleeper if you market it in the right way. You probably know that sleeper can be used in an obvious sense to refer to someone who is asleep. But you also may hear the word used to describe something that becomes an unexpected success, like "a sleeper of a film" featuring unknown actors that ends up becoming the big summer hit. This sense of the word may have originated in the world of gambling in the nineteenth century. When a card player unexpectedly drew a winning card, the card was called "a sleeper." Definitions of sleeper noun a rester who is sleeping see moresee less types: snorersomeone who snores while sleeping noun a passenger car that has berths for sleeping noun a piece of furniture that can be opened up into a bed noun pajamas with feet; worn by children see moresee less type of: jammies, pajama, pj's, pyjama(usually plural) loose-fitting nightclothes worn for sleeping or lounging; have a jacket top and trousers noun an unexpected achiever of success “the winner was a true sleeper--no one expected him to get it” “that movie was the sleeper of the summer” noun a spy or saboteur or terrorist planted in an enemy country who lives there as a law-abiding citizen until activated by a prearranged signal see moresee less type of: spy, undercover agent(military) a secret agent hired by a state to obtain information about its enemies or by a business to obtain industrial secrets from competitors terrorista radical who employs terror as a political weapon; usually organizes with other terrorists in small cells; often uses religion as a cover for terrorist activities noun one of the cross braces that support the rails on a railway track see moresee less type of: brace, bracinga structural member used to stiffen a framework noun tropical fish that resembles a goby and rests quietly on the bottom in shallow water "Sleeper."
